description: This PHP file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the saving process of marketing campaigns through a web wizard interface. It manages request parameters, updates email marketing beans, relates prospect lists, and queues campaign emails for sending or testing.

classes.name: EmailMarketing
classes.description: A bean representing email marketing campaigns, with methods for retrieval and persistence.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing campaign record by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the EmailMarketing bean, possibly with notifications.

methods.name: load_relationship
methods.description: Loads a specified relationship for the bean, e.g., prospect lists.

methods.name: prospectlists
methods.description: A relationship object managing prospect lists associated with the campaign.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes related prospect lists or relationship entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a prospect list to the campaign relationship.
